messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired (PD-45211) for service=autoscaler-rlp-eu-west-2  symptom: autoscaler oscillation causing 5xx spike and dropped connections, 11:07 UTC
maya: I'm oncall, ack'ing. joining bridge in 1m. any quick checks before I hop in?
tom: seeing controller logs with scale up/down every ~30s, target pool=rlp-dedicated-eu. many attachments failing with ECONNRESET. infra tagging.
raj: likely flapping due to aggressive cpu-based policy after the recent metrics change. previous commit altered the cpu threshold from 65->50. i'll check metrics config.
infra: we rolled autonomous metrics agent last night in eu-west-2, investigate agent telemetry mismatch.
maya: plan: 1) pause autoscaler 2) set desired replicas to stable value 3) route traffic to fallback pool 4) start post-incident review. agree?
tom: agree. i'll pause the autoscaler and set desired replicas. running:
```bash
nodectl autoscaler pause --pool rlp-dedicated-eu && nodectl pool scale rlp-dedicated-eu --replicas 12
```
pagerbot: action logged: autoscaler pause requested by tom at 11:09 UTC
raj: checked policy diff  commit 9f3a2 changed window from 300s->60s. that explains oscillation. recommend revert to 300s after we stabilize.
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook invoked: "autoscaler-flap" v1.4  recommended steps: pause, stabilize, adjust policy, monitor 15m.
maya: customer impact: Hosted API mostly unaffected; Dedicated pinned tenants on rlp-dedicated-eu showing 7-12% error rates over the last 8 minutes. notifying support to create incident tickets for affected accounts.
infra: routing rule applied to send new sessions to fallback pool 'rlp-fallback-eu'  confirmed 200 OK on health checks.
tom: autoscaler paused and replicas pinned to 12. healthcheck probe reports OK:
```json
{"pool":"rlp-dedicated-eu","replicas":12,"healthy":12}
```
raj: rolling back the metric window now to 300s. applying patch:
```sh
configctl set autoscaler.rlp.window 300s --commit "rollback metric window due to oscillation"
```
maya: sending customer update: "we have paused autoscaling and routed traffic to fallback. errors should reduce shortly. we will follow up with a postmortem." queued to send at 11:20 UTC.
tom: monitoring metrics  error rate dropping to 2% in last 3m. spike correlated with scaling events. good sign.
pagerbot: PD: ack recorded (maya) and incident labeled 'in-progress' at 11:12 UTC
raj: will leave a note to revert the earlier metrics change in the feature branch and add a canary test for autoscaler behavior.
sre-runbook-bot: Action log: autoscaler pause, set replicas=12, route to fallback, revert metric window.
maya: handoff: i'm staying on customer comms and will circle back with tom/raj for the postmortem. tom, can you lead the rollout of the metric revert?
tom: can do. starting rollout to staging then to prod once we watch 30m.
maya: next update 11:40 UTC or sooner if anything changes. thanks team.
pagerbot: PD: status changed to "monitoring" at 11:22 UTC  escalation timer set for 11:52 UTC
